bibliographic.title: Magnetic excitations of Sr3Ir2O7 observed by inelastic neutron scattering measurement

affiliations.text: Institute for Materials Research, Tohoku University, Katahira, Sendai 980-8577, Japan
Research Center for Neutron Science and Technology, Comprehensive Research Organization for Science and Society, Tokai, Ibaraki 319-1106, Japan
Materials and Life Science Division, J-PARC Center, Japan Atomic Energy Agency, Tokai, Ibaraki 319-1195, Japan

bibliographic.abstract: In this short note, we report on the first inelastic neutron scattering (INS) study on high-energy magnetic excitations in Sr3Ir2O7. We observed excitations between ∼80 meV and ∼180 meV. The peak position of the excitations is consistent with the dispersion of a single magnon determined by resonant inelastic X-ray scattering (RIXS) measurement. Thus, our results demonstrate the feasibility of INS for iridates, which has a large neutron absorption cross-section.

samples.sample_description: Approximately 500 crystals with a total mass of 2.1 grams were assembled on aluminum plates (with 0.1 mm thickness) such that the crystallographic c-axis is perpendicular to each plate.
samples.supplier_or_creator: prepared single crystals by the fluxmethod

datasets.dataset_description: INS measurements on Sr3Ir2O7 using a 250 meV incident neutron energy to determine the magnon excitations below 200 meV; signals were collected for two days under 300 kW beam power operation at 6 K.
